Title: Azure App Service new premium tier

Body.Content: The new premium tier from Azure App Service is now generally available. It features Dv2-series virtual machines with faster processors, SSD storage, and double memory-to-core ratio compared to the previous compute iteration. This is an ideal App Service option for apps that require high performance and scalability. For more information, please refer to the blog.
